exposure: Type of institute of antenatal care
cohort: 246 women in the labor room of a tertiary care hospital in Odisha, India
finding: While over a third of women reported good RMC overall, non-consented and non-confidential care were poorly rated, and barriers to RMC included lack of resources, staffing issues, and communication challenges.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was not associated with RMC.
